partner_commitments.co_design_cadence: fortnightly co-design working sessions plus a quarterly governed-workflow review
partner_commitments.rights_disclosure: Reference and logo rights are a contractual exchange the Founding partner grants in return for founding terms — withdrawable per the §49 directory-consent obligation, never auto-assumed, and never a substitute for the founding discount.

eligibility.eligibility_note: Early enterprise adopters in a regulated sector who will co-design real governed workflows. Meeting the profile qualifies you to apply; the cohort is capped at 10 and admission is §49 application-reviewed.
